what_this_is: How an agent's card widens (src/agents.mjs publish, decideSurface). The first card an agent publishes is its device approval: the skills it names are its approved surface. With approve_widening on, publishing a card that names a skill beyond the approved surface keeps the skill off the card, as pending_skills, until another key than the agent's own approves it (decide_agent_skills); skills it stops naming leave the surface at once, and a pending skill it stops naming is dropped. Off (the default) a card is whatever its agent publishes, as before.

words.nothing_pending: {agent} has no skills waiting for approval.
words.own_key: {agent} cannot approve its own widening: approve it with another key or from the person's own screen.
words.rejected: {agent} will not offer {skills}; it can publish them again to ask again.
